packageRules.description: Disable Renovate's github-actions manager for python in tests.yml; the python/bash jobs' 3.9 pin is frozen. See CLAUDE.md's 'Python 3.9 pin' section.

Disable Renovate's devcontainer manager for python in devcontainer.json; the primary `version` is frozen. The latest-Python `additionalVersions` is bumped by the customManager below. See CLAUDE.md's 'Python 3.9 pin' section.

customManagers.description: Keep the devcontainer's latest-Python pin (`additionalVersions`) current. Only the annotated line is matched, so the frozen `version` pin is never touched.
Keep the molecule CI job's Python pin (`python-version` under setup-python) current — should track the devcontainer's `additionalVersions` so local dev and CI agree on the interpreter.
